data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 旅馆阁楼上的浣熊耳动
data.action: 跪在铺着厚毯的木床上，毛茸茸的浣熊耳朵羞涩地压低贴在发丝间，大尾巴在身后不安地晃动，双手攥着被角轻声呼唤。
data.location: 边境小镇乡间旅馆阁楼，斜顶木天窗外满天繁星与银河流转
data.lighting: 天窗倾泻而下的银亮星光，照亮了少女饱含倾慕的琥珀色双瞳与温润肌肤
data.mood: 忠诚亚人少女的无尽信赖与从幼小成长为成熟女性的动人情愫
data.description: 边境小镇乡间旅馆阁楼，斜顶木天窗外满天繁星与银河流转。跪在铺着厚毯的木床上，毛茸茸的浣熊耳朵羞涩地压低贴在发丝间，大尾巴在身后不安地晃动，双手攥着被角轻声呼唤。 她微微抬眸轻语——“尚文大人……现在的我，已经不是当初那个弱小无助的小女孩了。我想作为您的依靠……留在您身边。”
data.promptProse: Kneeling on a thick-blanketed wooden bed inside a quiet frontier inn attic at night, Raphtalia wears a russet-brown linen criss-cross slip nightdress over an ivory cotton underlay laced with leather ties. Flattening her ears shyly while clutching the duvet edge and gazing up with devoted pink eyes, she rests where starry skylight meets warm hearth glow.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling barefoot on the rustic attic bed clutching the blanket hem in her russet-and-ivory lace-up linen nightdress, she lowers her ears shyly and looks up with heartfelt devotion. Silver starlight through the sloped skylight meets warm hearth firelight across the wooden loft.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a rustic russet-brown and ivory linen criss-cross slip nightdress laced across the front with soft leather cords.
